text: Experience with Salesforce and SFDC required to manage customer database.
Strong experience implementing HubSpot CRM for marketing alignment.
Requires extensive knowledge of SAP ERP and S/4 HANA deployments.
Experience managing Oracle Fusion or NetSuite integrations is a major plus.
Architecting secure infrastructure on Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Microsoft Azure.
Must have worked with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Kubernetes, and Terraform configurations.
Familiarity with Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and Adobe Analytics.
Building dashboards in Tableau Software or Microsoft Power BI for leadership.
Scripting expertise in Python and SQL (Postgres or MySQL).
Daily coordination using Jira, Slack, and Microsoft Teams.
Manage customer database in Salesforce CRM and deploy analytical models using Python and Amazon Web Services.
SAP S/4HANA operations with Google Cloud Platform database migrations and Tableau reporting.
This is a leadership role focused on people management, not coding or writing SQL.
Must collaborate across cloud engineering teams to understand requirements.
Familiarity with modern software development lifecycle methodologies.
Aligning with CRM specialists to understand system capabilities.
The marketing head will interact with analytics agencies.
Liaison with external ERP consultants during upgrades.
Help engineering teams choose cloud providers.
Understand the value of programming automation.
